text: Renfe (the brand on the back of Spain's rugby shirts) is Renfe-Operadora, a Spanish public business entity attached to the Ministry of Transport and Sustainable Mobility.
short: Renfe-Operadora is a Spanish state rail entity attached to the Ministry of Transport.

source.name: Renfe: Nuestra web (información legal)
source.note: Legal notice page without a date; opened 2026-10-04. English: 'Renfe-Operadora is a public business entity, a public body under article 103 of Law 40/2015. It is attached to the Ministry of Transport and Sustainable Mobility.'
source.quote: Renfe-Operadora es una entidad pública empresarial, organismo público de los previstos en el artículo 103 de la referida Ley 40/2015. Está adscrita al Ministerio de Transportes y Movilidad Sostenible
